title: TCL 75" C7L Premium Mini LED TV + TCL 2.1ch 220W Dolby Atmos Soundbar $1788.80 (via Price Check) + Del ($0 C&C) @ The Good Guys
body:
Deal: TCL 75" C7L Premium Mini LED TV + TCL 2.1ch 220W Dolby Atmos Soundbar $1788.80 (via Price Check) + Del ($0 C&C) @ The Good Guys

[maverickjohn] Thank you mods for the clarity on the unclear post
[UncleRico] Yet no love for the OP?
Ingrates abound…
[bruhminister] The 65" version ain't a bad deal either for 1459.
[itsmiffy] Have been waiting for a deal on an 85inch. The 85C7L with the 7.1.4ch sound system comes out at $3077 in cart and before trying gift cards. Mixed reviews on the sound bar capabilities from what I can tell.
Or $2568 with the cheaper sound bar. Suppose could try and sell for $100 and then have ~$500 into something else.
Seems like a good deal overall! Anyone have much luck getting delivery and install thrown in?
[El Grande] What about the 5.1 Soundbar? Its only a little over $100 more than this deal but 5.1 should be a lot better than 2.1?
[El Grande] I thought c8l was the ozbargain favourite? How does the c7l compare?
[TsunamiInTheHouse] C8 is the premium option, you pay more of a premium than relative viewing experience
C7 is the mid-high range value option
C6 is the budget option and not great because its significantly worse than the C7 despite only being 20-30% cheaper.
[softkun123] do you mean c8 is overrated/over priced and not worth the price? the difference between c7 and c8 is comming to be approx 700$
[31mop] Why am I getting $2016 for the two, delivered?
[31mop] Why am I getting $2016 for the two, delivered?
$2271 and $249 less 20%
[essent1al] i got this 5.1 soundbar instead https://www.thegoodguys.com.au/tcl-51-ch-dolby-atmos-soundba…
its already on special too
came to $1950 all up
[ReaperX22] Worth just to get a centre channel imo. Heck I'd probably try to configure it just to be 3.1!
[essent1al] can you please elaborate, did i mess up choosing this soundbar?
[SometimesStingy] Nope you did good!
They mean instead of having the soundbar running at a surround sound setup, they would have it running with no “surround” so it would be a more front sounding speaker.
Hence 3.1 - left, right, centre + sub (.1)
Instead of 5.1, which would have two drivers on the end giving it a surround feel.
When you get your soundbar they’ll likely be some button or switch :) just try both out for a few hours and see what you like. Both will sound very good
[SometimesStingy] @essent1al: You’re very welcome.
Remember to run it over HDMI if it supports which will give you arc/eArc, that way you can use your tv remote as a single remote, and you want something called passthrough audio in your settings, because that will pass pure audio (e.g. Dolby Atmos) to the soundbar.
This will be very nice setup for movies! Very nice
[essent1al] @SometimesStingy: Okay i will thanks brother, I cant wait :))
[ReaperX22] @essent1al: Haha yeah sorry for any confusion!
I just find soundbars the 'surround' function is hit or miss. It's fairly hard to simulate surround when…. It doesn't surround you heh. But I reckon having the centre channel is pretty essential.
Your pick is what I would've gone for too.
Enjoy the new setup!
[kehuehue] I got it for 1800, the TV wasnt picking up a lower price 2 days before. Order is still pending, soundbar shipped and TV pending 15/06. can i cancel or ask for store credit for the difference?
i tried chat to price match the soundbar even lower ($185) but got two dimwits as sales reps who couldnt put the deals together.
[speedyjonzalas] Can anyone offer some advice… ive been eyeing up the c8k but ive been a bit unsure if its going to be too bright for the room.
My tv room is dark. Is the c7L a better option for me than a C8L?
We watch a lot of tv and movies, and its also our main gaming tv, though i woild prioritise tv and movies over gaming.
[ifreddo] C7L Will be completely fine for you. If you get a chance, check them out in store. The C7L is plenty bright.
[speedyjonzalas] Thanks, is that the main difference between the two models? Is there any real difference of other parts or is it more a case of same LED but less bright?
[djokerer] Most important difference imo is the C8L has more dimming zones, thus better local dimming
[Wrongguy] Better processor in the newer models, helps with upscaling. Also, 4 HDMI 2.1 ports in C8L
[xopticghostx] Can anyone confirm how these perform in bright environments I currently have a LG C1 and it reflects just about everything onto the glossy screen?
[jv] They are excellent for bright rooms…
Look at some of the reviews on youtube.
[Jdeeebo] I ordered a LG QNED86B last week. Is it a no brainer swapping for the C7L?
[djokerer] Absolutely. The LG QNED is edge-lit, not real full array mini LED. Overpriced for outdated tech and vastly inferior image quality. Definitely swap it while you still can.
[Dienk] Also terrible brand. LG = Little Garbage
[bigdoggo] I just bought this literally on Wednesday for 2200 at bing lee, can I do anything about it 😭😭. It's already open and set up.
[inamberclad] good deal thanks op. Still sour about missing the 65C8K but this alleviates the pain :)
[tellhimhesdreaming] Oof interesting find OP, 55 with the 5.1 bar seems to come to $1219. Pretty solid
[El Grande] Thinking about buying this for the bedroom. Split if I should get the 75 for Living or 55 for bedroom.
[phbk] Thanks, got one. I was hanging out for a good deal for the 75C8L but I'm old blind and deaf so probably won't notice the difference anyway.
[worthy1] Trying hard not to buy this one, but it doesnt seem to get good reviews for gaming and sport due to motion blur at all refresh rates. I would be replacing our Sony X9000h LED from 2020 which its heavily used for gaming on a PS5, so i dont want to have issues. Then again i do game on the TCL C755 and i dont seem to notice issues, unless the motion issues came up on the the new models.
[theg00s3] what do people do with the soundbar if they don’t need it? I have a Samsung 930c so I don’t really need an upgrade
[bAps] gift to someone, sell it on marketplace, etc
[Ghogger] I’ve been looking for a deal on the 75C7K but they’re all out of stock. This is exactly what I was after, thanks so much OP :)
I wonder if they’ll let us keep the discount if we return the soundbar for change of mind, invoice shows $1600.80 for the TV alone, great price!
